card.title: Samsung Galaxy A13 5G(A137) Not Charging

claims.statement: Galaxy A13 5G not charging after a bad charger: check 5 V at VBUS IN, then at VBUS IF FL (bypassable coil); missing there usually means a blown OVP IC—replace it or bypass it (higher future risk).
VPH coil should hold a stable 3.7–4.2 V; unstable with good diode reading suggests the charging IC.
Bootcap: 3.7–4.2 V one side and roughly double on the other; otherwise faulty bootcap (fake charging) or charging IC.

procedure: With charger only: VBUS IN, VBUS IF FL.
Check VPH coil and bootcap voltages; replace charging IC if needed.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Bypassing OVP raises the risk of charging IC damage from bad chargers.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
